data.description: Using the powers of necromancy, you can determine the condition of creatures near death within the spell's range. You instantly know whether each creature within the area is dead, fragile [alive and wounded, with 3 or fewer hit points left], fighting off death [alive with 4 or more hit points], healthy, undead, or neither alive nor dead [such as a construct]. Deathwatch sees through any spell or ability that allows creatures to feign death.
